verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury is a financial-services SaaS that handles sensitive customer data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use privacy control is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI model training, data-use policies or opt-out controls. The items cover money movement, accounts, fraud controls and developer tooling, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
